concerns.text: FR-008 mandates strict exclusion of non-kinetic labels with NO fallback. Task T013 description states 'ensure NO fallback mechanism exists', but the Plan (FR/SC Mapping) explicitly describes a 'fallback to Structure-Verified' strategy. This contradiction means the tasks do not clearly implement the spec's hard constraint. A task must be added or clarified to resolve this conflict and ensure the 'NO fallback' rule is implemented.

FR-001 requires converting raw IR and NMR data into a single '512-bin fixed-length fingerprint' (Spectral Fingerprint entity). Tasks T011 and T012 cover fetching NIST (IR) and PubChem (NMR) data separately. There is no explicit task to MERGE these two sources into the unified 512-bin vector entity defined in the spec. Without a merge task, the pipeline may produce disjoint datasets, failing FR-001.

SC-005 requires measuring class balance against a specific metric (max/min ratio <= 2). Task T016 only 'flags' classes with <50 samples. There is no task to calculate the specific ratio metric or record it as a verifiable output artifact required to satisfy SC-005 evidence.

FR-004 and SC-003 require a permutation test to calculate a p-value. FR-007 requires Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) correction on 'per-bin' p-values. Task T031 performs a 'single model-level' test (producing one p-value), and T031a extracts importance scores. Neither task explicitly generates the 'per-bin' p-values required for the BH correction in T032. The statistical pipeline for FR-007/SC-003 is incomplete.

FR-010 requires validating top bins via DFT or literature. Task T033a sets up DFT, but the Analyze Report notes this was previously rejected for missing artifacts. There is no task to handle the fallback strategy (e.g., literature-only validation) if local DFT is infeasible within the 6-hour constraint, risking a blocker for FR-010.

FR-006 requires avoiding causal language. Tasks T024 and T025 implement framing and filtering but lack a task to explicitly VERIFY the output (e.g., a regex audit step) that the report is free of forbidden words, making the requirement's 'Independent Test' subjective.
